lines.text: Many learners say: I bought bread in the magazine.
Better: I bought bread in the shop.
Magazine is a thing to read.
Shop! I buy milk in a shop.

data.wrong: I bought bread in the magazine.
data.right: I bought bread in the shop.
data.why: Magazine is a thing to read.

native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I bought bread in the magazine.”? 😅 “Magazine” похоже на «магазин», но это журнал. Магазин — “shop” или “store”. Правильно: “I bought bread in the shop.”. Послушай Ама и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “shop”. Магазин — shop, журнал — magazine. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: “Magazine” means a journal. A store is a “shop”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I bought bread in the magazine.”? 😅 “Magazine” looks like the Russian word for shop, but it means a journal. A store is “shop”. Correct: “I bought bread in the shop.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
